nonBlockingRisks: Eligibility is limited to current user-confirmed machine-local pure HTTPS-backed bytes.
Registry, vault, source, base or manifest drift fails closed before update mutation.
Background, cross-source, local-file/ZIP/chat update and public restore remain out of scope.
